clinical.disclaimer: Decision-support estimate. Check the input data; targets and decisions depend on the medical prescription and the unit protocol.

urr.optimal: URR ≥ {target} %: meets the usual dose target.
urr.adequate: URR between {minimum} % and {target} %: meets the recommended minimum (≥ {minimum} %), below the {target} % target.
urr.alert: URR below the recommended minimum of {minimum} %: report it per protocol and review the sampling technique.

ktv.optimal: spKt/V ≥ {target}: meets the target for hemodialysis {sessionsPerWeek} times a week.
ktv.adequate: spKt/V between {minimum} and {target}: meets the minimum delivered dose, below the {target} target.
ktv.alert: spKt/V below the minimum dose of {minimum}: notify the nephrologist and review time, flows and samples.
ktv.info: With {sessionsPerWeek} sessions per week the 1.2/1.4 thresholds (defined for thrice-weekly HD) do not apply; interpret with the nephrologist.

idwg.alert: Gain above {threshold} % of dry weight (commonly used threshold): consider fluid restriction and hypotension risk.
idwg.info: Pre-dialysis weight is lower than the previous post weight: no gain.

ufRate.caution: Rate between {caution} and {alert} mL/kg/h: closely monitor hemodynamic tolerance.
ufRate.alert: Rate above {alert} mL/kg/h (KDOQI 2015): associated with higher cardiovascular risk; check the prescription (session time, target weight).

fluidBalance.negative: Negative balance: more fluid was removed than given.
fluidBalance.positive: Positive balance: more fluid was given than removed.

errors.post_bun_not_lower: post-dialysis BUN must be lower than pre-dialysis BUN.
errors.ktv_out_of_domain: data fall outside the formula's domain (R − 0.008·t ≤ 0); check BUN and duration.
errors.implausible_weight_change: the weight change between sessions is implausible; check the weights.
errors.no_fluid_data: enter at least one intake or output.

safety.disclaimer: NefroIA is a decision-support tool: it does not diagnose or prescribe. Follow your unit protocol and medical orders. Do not enter patient-identifying data.

redaction.body: {count, plural, one {# personal data item was} other {# personal data items were}} hidden ({types}) before sending the message to the model. Use initials or pseudonyms.

redFlags.title: Possible emergency: act now
redFlags.body: Follow the unit emergency protocol immediately, notify the physician on duty and call for help. Do not wait for the assistant's answer.
